title: JD Young Category Assistant Internships
full_description:
Who We Are
At JD.com, also known as JINGDONG, everything begins with a bold idea and the drive to make life smarter, faster, and more connected. What started in China has grown into one of the world’s most trusted technology and supply chain ecosystems, serving over 700 million customers. From retail and logistics to tech, property, and beyond, we’re all about innovation that actually makes a difference.
Our Global Reach
JD.com is expanding worldwide through a digitally intelligent, cross-border supply chain and world-class logistics network. With platforms like Joybuy connecting trusted products to customers everywhere, our teams stretch across China, the U.S., Europe, APAC, the Middle East, and beyond. Every year, we welcome over 20,000 students and graduates into our business, showing our commitment to young talent and the fresh ideas that drive our future. Join us and contribute to global projects from day one.
Learn more about who we are and what we do:
https://corporate.jd.com/
What We Offer
We believe great ideas can come from anywhere, and often, they come from you. As an intern at JD.com, you’ll work on meaningful, hands-on projects, learn from talented colleagues across our global network, and grow in a supportive, fast-paced environment designed for development. With competitive compensation, great office locations, and a people-first culture that champions continuous learning, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and kick-start your career.
About Your Program
You’ll be joining the JD Young (JDY) Internship Program, designed to give early-career talent hands-on exposure to real projects, real responsibilities, and real growth. Over 3–6 months, you’ll work alongside experienced teams, build fundamental skills, and gain insights into how a global business operates.
Alongside mentorship and learning experiences your day to day role will cover responsibilities such as:
Assist in market research and data analysis to identify category trends, competitor activities, and customer preferences.
Support the creation and maintenance of product listings, including data entry, image management, and content optimization.
Help monitor category performance metrics, such as sales, inventory levels, and conversion rates, and generate reports.
Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., marketing, operations) to execute promotional campaigns and product launches.
Participate in competitive benchmarking and propose strategies for category improvement.
Support the Category Manager in preparing presentations and reports for internal stakeholders.
Perform other administrative tasks as assigned to ensure smooth category operations.
About You
Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, E-commerce, or a related field. Preferably students in final semester, graduating in 2026.
Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Microsoft Excel (e.g., pivot tables, VLOOKUP).
Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing.
Proactive and eager to learn in a fast-paced e-commerce environment.
Familiarity with e-commerce platforms or online retail is a plus.
Ability to commit to a minimum of 3-6 months for the internship. Proficiency in English and Chinese is required; German language skills are a plus
At JD.com, we are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where every voice counts and every talent belongs. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any legally protected characteristic.
Ready To Apply?
Don't leave yourself wondering 'what if'. Hit apply and see where your curiosity can take you at JD.com.

title: Analyst - BCG Vantage
full_description:
Who We Are
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
What You'll Do
As an Analyst – BCG Vantage on our Topic Activation path within BCG's TDA Practice Area, you will work in a growing global team, being involved in several of our fast-growing topics, such as (Gen)AI, Agentic AI, and digital transformation, helping shape our offering and working directly with case and proposal teams, providing expert advisory, analysis, and digital, tech, and AI insights. You’ll serve as a thought partner and content expert to case teams and topic/sector leaders, helping structure and solve complex issues.
You will support commercialization efforts for the topic/sector working, in conjunction with business leaders, through contributing analysis and insights to proposals, client workshops, AI demos, and marketing materials related to (Gen)AI and digital transformation. Additionally, as an Analyst – BCG Vantage, you will contribute to developing intellectual property & assets for the business and assist in onboarding and training junior colleagues based on your topic/sector expertise.
YOU'RE GOOD AT
Solving client problems by developing and applying analytical and structured approaches in digital and AI contexts
Communicating confidently and credibly with case teams, stakeholders, and topic leaders
Working collaboratively in both in-person and virtual team settings
Navigating ambiguity and adapting to fast-paced, evolving digital topics
Bringing a curious and creative mindset, open to innovation and continuous improvement
What You'll Bring
Master's degree relevant to sector/topic; or Bachelor's degree, with 2+ years of relevant work experience in sector / topic
Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts, digital transformation narratives, agentic AI platforms, apps, ecosystems, market trends, use cases and enabling technologies / data / algorithms
Familiarity with software development projects, particularly those using Agile methodologies, is beneficial to understand the complexity of technological development and adoption.
Excellent Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) is a plus
Programming experience (e.g., Python, SQL) not required but beneficial
Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred
Fluent English required; additional European languages are a plus
Strong business acumen, problem-solving, and communication skills
Who You'll Work With
As an Analyst within the Digital & AI Transformation team, you will report to a
Manager
in the team and collaborate closely with case teams and topic leaders (Partners and MDPs). You’ll work with colleagues across BCG’s TDA network, combining cutting-edge AI, analytics, and digital expertise with strategic insights to deliver client and practice impact.
Additional info
BCG Vantage is a powerhouse of expertise, seamlessly embedded within Practice Areas and markets to drive extraordinary impact. It equips BCG case teams and clients with cutting-edge expertise, proprietary assets, actionable data, and transformative insights that empower our case teams and enable our clients to achieve their aspirations.
With global experts across 20 Practices, covering more than 100 topics, sectors and offers, plus four focused geographic markets, BCG Vantage delivers unparalleled depth and breadth of insight & expertise. BCG Vantage consists of three career paths, each playing a crucial role in delivering value to clients, case teams and practice teams.
Client Focus (Embedded Expertise)
Integrates into client-facing teams to deliver direct client impact through expertise, know-how, and proprietary tools and assets
Topic Activation (Sector Expertise with Proprietary Tool & Data Solutions)
Combines deep domain insights with our know-how and proprietary assets to address targeted challenges directly with clients and project teams; co-creates insights on industry trends and functional topics, proprietary data and tools, and teams to codify IP that all enables BCG to deliver excellent business value with its clients
Research (Practice Topic and Sector-Aligned Research and Insights)
Delivers actionable research and insights tailored to the client project’s needs; works with qualitative and quantitative data, conducts research and provides synthesized results from sources including commercial data, public and open source, company and industry research, macro-economic, commodities and trade data.
Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.
BCG is an E - Verify Employer. Click here  for more information on E-Verify.

title: Consultant Climate Strategy (f/m/d)
full_description:
Your Responsibilities
Are you passionate about driving change and helping companies achieve their climate goals? We’re looking for someone who can:
Support our Climate Strategy Team in developing and implementing tailored climate strategies for companies
Independently conduct analysis and accounting of greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions
Advise on measures to scientifically reduce GHG emissions
Further develop existing accounting methods, processes, and tools, particularly digital solutions for carbon management in companies
Contribute to the ongoing knowledge development on current trends in areas relevant to our team and service portfolio, such as GHG accounting standards, Science-Based Targets, reduction strategies, and climate risk analysis
Support the team in customer management
Independently manage and advise clients
Your profile
Your educational background is in Economics or Business Administration
You have gained initial professional experience in sustainability consulting with a focus on greenhouse gas accounting and management
You are experienced in client relations and project management
You have a strong background in data management
You have experience with supply chain analysis in the context of decarbonization
You are familiar with Lifecycle Assessments (LCAs)
You have initial experience in climate risk analysis
You understand the business model implications of decarbonization strategies
Fluency in both German and English is a must-have requirement
What We Offer
Collaboration in an international interdisciplinary and dynamic team
Exciting field of work at the interface between business and climate protection
A casual work environment with impact
A comprehensive introduction to our team and processes while providing the space to develop your own solutions – new ideas are expressly welcome
Remote work possible if preferred
Regular training and capacity building
OUR MISSION:
We let values GROW:
we grow well financed, managed and monitored forests and ecosystems
we grow long-term alliances with project stakeholders and clients
we grow financial mechanisms and payment for ecosystem services to scale and improve projects
we grow transparency and traceability through robust carbon standards, digital solutions, and earth observation technologie
we grow the competency of our team by trainings, education and onboarding world leading experts.
We create positive impact on our CLIMATE:
we partner with implementation organizations, international investors and development banks to develop the most robust climate projects
we help industry clients to account and manage their greenhouse emissions
we monitor, report and verify impact and results of performance indicators
we create climate solutions that are based on scientific research
we initiate transformation to fight climate change and to achieve carbon targets.
We take ACTION:
we mobilize finance for ecosystem services and develop new integrated value chains together with local stakeholders
we use nature to build robust and proven carbon sinks by applying internationally recognized carbon standards and methodologies
we turn carbon reduction plans into concrete action, and projects
we think new ways and combine proven nature-based solutions with innovative financial mechanisms and state-of-the-art technology
we unlock new climate action project types and promote developing of new methodologies for carbon sinks.
About Us
FORLIANCE
initiates, finances, creates and manages robust nature- based climate projects and integrates them into sustain-ability strategies with our clients to achieve their Net Zero Carbon targets. Together with our global partners, and our 50+ team members in ten countries, we strive to create intact forests and ecosystems that positively impact our climate, biodiversity and human well-being. We offer companies effective solutions for climate protection by developing individual climate protection strategies.

title: Internship Brand Innovation Syoss Masterbrand & Color EU
full_description:
About this Position
As a SYOSS Intern, you will be part of the EU Innovation Brand Team of one of Henkel’s most iconic hair brands. From day one, you will gain hands-on experience in international brand management and actively contribute to shaping innovations and communication strategies across markets. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to bring SYOSS initiatives to life. This is not a back-office internship - you will have real ownership, real exposure and real impact.
What You´ll Do
Support the development and execution of innovations within the Hair Coloration category
Assist in the creation of product concepts for consumer testing, including concept writing, claiming and packaging exploration
Support in identifying emerging trends, consumer pain points and category opportunities in Hair Coloration
Analyze market data, competitor launches and existing consumer knowledge to inform the innovation planning
Collaborate with the research team to validate concepts
Facilitate the coordination among cross-functional teams (R&D, Supply Chain, Legal/Regulatory, Finance, etc.) and external agencies to ensure timely delivery of selected innovation projects
Track project timelines, budgets and deliverables accordingly and ensure adherence to brand guidelines across all possible touchpoints
What makes you a good fit
Student who has successfully passed first semesters of business-related studies
Practical experience in FMCG or beauty marketing as well as market analysis and interpretation is beneficial
Excellent English language skills, German and other languages are advantageous
Firm knowledge of MS PowerPoint, Excel and Power BI
Creative mindset with a strong attention to detail
Team-player with a high level of independence
Self-motivated, creative and open-minded personality
Some perks of joining Henkel
Diverse national and international growth opportunities
Globally wellbeing standards with health and preventive care programs
Attractive Remuneration
Flexible working hours and hybrid work model
Global Experience
Interns Community
We offer you an attractive salary between €1.050-2.270 gross per month. The exact amount of the remuneration depends on the desired duration, the type of internship (voluntary or mandatory) and existing degrees.
At Henkel, we come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe the uniqueness of all our employees is the power in us. Become part of the team and bring your uniqueness to us! We welcome all applications across different genders, origins, cultures, religions, sexual orientations, generations and disabilities. If there are any specific accommodations or adjustments you require for the interview process or your on-site appointment, please inform us, and we'll do our best to accommodate your requests.

full_description:
B
ecome our next commercial rockstars!
Are you ready to dive into the dynamic world of electronic components and discover the entrepreneur in you with Smith? Our 3-month internship program is your chance to gain hands-on experience, expand your commercial skillset, and get your first commercial deal.
Founded in 1984, Smith sources manages, and distributes the electronic components that go into everything from mobile phones and computers to appliances and automobiles. Smith is the leading independent distributor of electronic components and ranks number seven among all global distributors.
In 19 cities around the world, our legion of employees communicates in 50 different languages and dialects and buys and sells components 24 hours per day, with global sales in excess of $12 billion over the last five years. We’re always moving; helping manufacturers navigate market shifts, customizing supply chain solutions, testing components using cutting-edge technology, and more.

Master the art of data manipulation and ensure seamless order flow.
Build authentic connections with customers

Generate sales leads like a rockstar, expanding your network and driving business growth.
We’re seeking for the next generation of commercial talents:
Ambitious individuals with a passion for building relationships.
Communication wizards who excel at collaboration, both verbally and in writing.
Team players who thrive in fast-paced environments, adapting to new challenges with agility.
Multilingual talents can flex your language skills and make a global impact. English and any other European languages are welcomed!
We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer.

SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. At PUMA, we push limits – not only in sport but also in how we work. As an
Analyst Automation
, you will play a key role in driving our automation agenda across the EMEA region and contributing to the global automation program.

Manage projects within the Global Automation program in close alignment with the Global Project Manager
Apply, promote, and continuously enhance automation best practices.

We are looking for a proactive and business‑oriented automation professional who thrives in a dynamic, international environment.

A university degree (B.S. or M.S.) in Computer Science, Business & Information Systems Engineering, or a related field

Experience with automation tools such as UiPath, Power Automate, or Process Mining (strong advantage)

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to adapt to change
Strong cross‑cultural communication skills
The ability to manage timelines while maintaining high standards in a fast‑paced environment
A service‑oriented mindset
Fluency in Business English.
This job opportunity will be available in full-time or part-time.
PUMA supports over 21,000 employees across 120+ countries. The PUMA Group owns the brand PUMA, Cobra Golf and stichd, and is headquartered in Herzogenaurach, Germany.

title: Volunteer: Amazonian Arts: Pottery, Jewelry, Weaving, Dance, and Music in Ecuador
full_description:
Location
: Tena, Ecuador
Duration
: minimum 4 weeks
Start Dates
: Start dates are each month, enquire with us when applying.
Cost
: $500 for the 1st week + $350 for each additional week
Fee Includes: all food, accommodation, pre-departure + in-country support, orientation and all project related activities
Does not Include: flights, airport pickup, travel insurance, personal spending, visas and vaccinations
Benefits
Learn about Amazonian cultures through the mediums of art, pottery, jewelry-making, basket weaving, dance, and music
Incorporate local traditions in art and music with your skills and interests and collaborate on events for the community
Gain experience in designing and implementing art and music workshops for kids and adults in schools, shelters, and after-school programs
Practice your own works of art and dance to share with locals and your community back home
Shadow masters in Amazonian arts, and learn how they use all-natural, plant-based ingredients to create materials
Research +amp; dissertation support available with partner organizations and universities, if requested
Keywords: art, art history, culture, design, jewelry-making, dance, music, theatre, weaving, local products, pottery, ceramics, natural products, economic development, sustainable development, indigenous traditions.
Please note:
This opportunity is designed to give you the contacts and experience to help further your career. You are not replacing any member of staff, but helping alongside them, whilst learning new skills.
Simply click the APPLY Button
to submit your application, and ask as many questions as you need.
Introduction
The Amazon rainforest is one of the most biodiverse ecosystems in the world and has thousands of species of plants, insects, and animals. For thousands of years, Amazonian indigenous peoples have been utilizing the gifts of the
Pachamama
- Mother Earth - to create art and goods, such as bowls, cups, paints, jewelry, and even clothes. Also, many local dances celebrate the earth for her gifts and others tell stories of life in the rainforest including hunting, animal encounters, falling in love, and marriage.
This internship is a unique opportunity to experience the cultures of the Ecuadorian Amazon through the mediums of art, pottery, music, and dance .Interns support on-going arts projects and have the opportunity to design and implement their own workshops about art, marketing, tourism, or a different topic of interest with locals.
Depending on the needs of the placement, potential internship activities include:
Learn about the different art forms of the host community and who makes the artisan goods
Attend music, dance, and storytelling events led by community members
Hike through agroforestry farms in the forest and collect natural materials for drawing, jewelry-making, dying, and ceramics
Practice different forms of art with locals, including weaving baskets and bags, making jewelry, wood carving, and more
Assist local entrepreneurs with design and marketing of their woven goods, jewelry, and other products
Design and implement arts-based workshops to share with community members
Design and implement workshops topics related to a topic of interest and that incorporate art as a method of transmitting knowledge; using art to talk about recycling, environmental conservation, leadership, self-esteem, etc.
Assist with tourism activities, including cooking, preparing cabins, guiding visitors, translating, and explaining on-going art projects
Organize English lessons with locals who are eager to advance their language skills and receive Spanish and Kichwa lessons from them as well
An Average Day For An Arts Intern Looks Like
Wake up and have breakfast with host family (***If you are with a very traditional indigenous family, you can wake up with them at 4 or 5am and share in the ritual of drinking guayusa tea as a family. ALSO, morning is when most families work on making artisan goods.***)
Head to the chakra (agroforestry farm), activity with local artisan, independent research, and/or assist with tourism activities
Lunch with host family (***OR: When interns are in the field they can buy lunch or bring a packed lunch***)
Continue research, finish up daily tasks, and practice weaving, jewelry-making, etc.
Return home around 5/6 pm for dinner with the family (***We encourage interns to spend as many evenings and weekends as possible with their host families to make the most of their immersions, learn about the culture, and practice their Spanish***)
Other activities to get involved in after work and on the weekends: sports, clubs, teaching English, meeting up with other interns, going on weekend trips to nearby tourist destinations, swimming in rivers, rafting, hikes to waterfalls and swimming holes, chocolate-making
Please note:
all information above is subject to change. Please check the most up to date information on the Global Nomadic website when applying. Simply follow the link on the Apply Button above.

acemate is building an AI learning & teaching platform for higher and further education institutions. We have strong traction, secured funding and are entering an exciting growth phase. We're looking for a passionate
Full-Stack Developer (Intern)
to drive our product forward and help us scale.
About acemate
Founded in 2024, acemate has quickly become the leading AI learning platform for higher and further education, trusted by top-tier institutions across four countries, including
University of Cologne
,
WHU
and the
German Chambers of Commerce and Industry (IHKs)
.
Our Mission:
Democratizing access to personalized learning. We don’t believe that AI will replace educators. Instead, we empower them to design and deliver personalized learning experiences at scale.
Our Growth:
We've raised pre-seed funding and are growing rapidly. While we focus on higher and further education today, we're already expanding into new regions and markets.
Our Culture:
We’re a young, driven team passionate about tackling the toughest challenges in education. We embrace builder culture and minimize scheduled meetings for ad-hoc discussions and maximized focus on coding and creating.

Antong
(CEO):
BCG, BMW & Antler background, leads business strategy, DJ by night
Jan
(CTO):
NLP research, experience from SAP & N26, morning bike commuter
Paul

TypeScript specialist, functional programming enthusiast, chief photography officer

Specialist in modern large-scale web architecture, escape room explorer
Ammar
(Fullstack):
Ex‑founder with webdev and blockchain experience, a learning violinist
Hanna
(Marketing):
Social media & creative design, Scandinavian sports enthusiast turned Berlin city girl
Tasks

Your role will evolve based on your strengths and interests, spanning both product development and technical infrastructure. As a core team member, you'll have significant influence on product decisions, technical architecture and overall strategy.

Build new features and enhance existing ones, working closely with Paul and Emile
Listen to users and translate feedback into product improvements
Technical Leadership:
Ensure robustness and scalability as we grow
Continuously improve AI toolchains to leverage the latest AI advancements
Work with cutting-edge technology built largely on Cloudflare and Google Cloud

Duolingo-inspired daily quiz system
to engage students with university content

that extract textual and visual content from diverse documents and embed topics in knowledge graphs

to handle growing complexity across different institutional settings
Tech Stack:

TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind CSS

Supabase (PostgreSQL)
Infrastructure:
Cloudflare (Workers, Pages, Workflows, R2, KV), Google Cloud (Gemini, Cloud Run)
Tools:
Sentry, Langfuse, PostHog, Stripe
Don't worry if you're not familiar with everything from the start. We believe in your ability to learn fast and adapt to new frameworks and tools as we go.
Requirements
What We're Looking For
Ownership mindset:
You think like a founder and treat the product like it’s yours
Commitment to excellence:
You’re driven to go above and beyond when it matters
Curiosity and adaptability:
Eager to learn new technologies and stay open to innovation
Balanced AI approach:
You knew how to code before Cursor and AI tools, but understand how to leverage them effectively
Availability:
6-month fixed internship duration

Benefits
Working in a small but driven team built around performance and learning
Flexible environment with high degree of autonomy and option to work remotely
Frequent team events and acemate parties! 🥳

full_description:
Start Date:
June 1, 2026
acemate is building an AI learning & teaching platform for higher and further education institutions. We have strong traction, secured funding and are entering an exciting growth phase. We're looking for a passionate
Mobile App Developer (React Native)
to drive our product forward and help us scale.
About acemate
Founded in 2024, acemate has quickly become the leading AI learning platform for higher and further education, trusted by top-tier institutions across four countries, including
University of Cologne
,
WHU
and the
German Chambers of Commerce and Industry (IHKs)
.
Our Mission:
Democratizing access to personalized learning. We don’t believe that AI will replace educators. Instead, we empower them to design and deliver personalized learning experiences at scale.
Our Growth:
We've raised pre-seed funding and are growing rapidly. While we focus on higher and further education in the DACH area today, we're already expanding into new regions and markets.
Our Culture:
We’re a young, driven team passionate about tackling the toughest challenges in education. We embrace builder culture and minimize scheduled meetings for ad-hoc discussions and maximized focus on coding and creating.
Tasks
What You'll Do
As
Mobile Software Developer
and a core team member, you will be a core product owner with significant influence on our mobile architecture and user experience. You will take end-to-end ownership of the systems that power our mobile features, from UI architecture and state management to API integration and performance monitoring.
Build the product, not just the UI:
You will take full responsibility for the features you build. This means designing intuitive user flows, managing sophisticated local state, and ensuring a snappiness that feels native. You build it, you ship it, you improve it.
Architect for scale and intelligence:
You’ll design scalable mobile architectures (using modern patterns like MVVM or TCA) that integrate deeply with our Effect-based backend and AI systems. You’ll handle the complexity of offline-first logic, real-time synchronization, and streaming AI responses.
Drive technical excellence:
You will proactively identify performance bottlenecks—like app startup time and render cycles—while raising the bar for UX consistency, type safety, and maintainability across the entire codebase.
Requirements
What We're Looking For
Strong experience
with TypeScript & React Native.
End-to-End Ownership:
You don’t throw things over the wall. You own your features until they are running successfully in production and used by real learners.
Startup experience
: You’re comfortable in fast-paced, evolving environments
Balanced AI approach:
You knew how to code before Cursor and Claude Code, but understand how to leverage them effectively
Product passion:
High identification with our mission to transform education
Benefits
Benefits
Competitive salary package with equity component
Fully covered Deutschlandticket
JobRad (bike or e-bike via leasing, also for private use )
Working in a small but driven team built around performance and learning
Flexible environment with high degree of autonomy and option to work remotely
Frequent team events and acemate parties! 🥳

title: Digital Product Owner (all genders) - simplesurance
full_description:
Your platform for simple access to insurance
simplesurance is a leading insurtech company specializing in the seamless integration of innovative insurance technology into the digital workflows of business partners across diverse industries. Founded in 2012 and part of Allianz since 2022, simplesurance plays a pivotal role in enhancing customer experiences in fast growing ecosystems like banking, automotive, e-commerce, and travel.
An international team of over 350 technology experts from more than 30 countries develops scalable B2B and B2C solutions — ranging from robust APIs to fully integrated service portals and customer-facing platforms.
With its headquarters in Berlin and teams across Munich, Paris, Lisbon, Dubai, and Beirut, simplesurance is driving the global transformation of digital insurance solutions.
About The Job
We’re looking for a Digital Product Owner to join Vladislava Zubareva's Team and make a real impact! Ready to take on new challenges? As part of our team, you’ll be contributing to cutting-edge projects that are shaping the future of our company and the industry.
At simplesurance, we don’t just embrace change – we drive it. With a strong commitment to innovation, resilience, and growth, we continuously challenge the status quo while having fun along the way, true to our motto: "Never Stop Playing".
As a Digital Product Owner at simplesurance, you’ll experience firsthand how technology and innovation work to fuel our growth.
We invite you to check out some of the tools and projects that drive our work:
TechShare: See the tools we use to power our business.
GitHub Repository: Explore our open-source projects.
Integration Overview: Get a look at how our integrations work.
Stay updated with our latest news on LinkedIn.
Key Responsibilities
Own and maintain product roadmap and backlog (JIRA / Confluence).
Write and refine epics and user stories with strong business analysis.
Manage stakeholder expectations and identify risks/dependencies proactively.
Act as the main product interface for developers, QA, BAs, and business stakeholders.
Maintain shared understanding of scope, priorities, and delivery timelines.
Bring to the Team
Strong business analysis skills with the ability to write clear, actionable epics and user stories.
Practical experience working with agile teams and participating in Scrum ceremonies.
High-level technical understanding, including front-end vs back-end concepts, environments, and architecture diagrams (no coding required).
Proactive, communicative, and user-centric mindset with strong stakeholder skills and GDPR awareness.
Curious, adaptable, and open to feedback, with a willingness to learn from both technical and non-technical teammates.
Even if you don’t check all the boxes, we are happy to receive your CV.
What We Offer
At simplesurance, you will get an all-round feel-good package including:
Flexible Benefits: Choose from a free “Deutschland ticket” or a subsidy for Internet usage.
Work-Life Balance: A hybrid environment that fosters flexibility, and an accessible working-from-abroad policy of up to 25 days per year.
Time to Recharge: 28 vacation days a year, plus full paid time off for Christmas and New Year’s Eve, giving you the time to relax and celebrate.
Financial Growth: Allianz shares guided by our investment policy and an exceptional company-supported pension plan.
Sabbatical Programme: After your first year at simplesurance, you’re entitled to take a sabbatical leave of up to 2 months.
Continuous Learning: Access our Degreed platform, offering a range of learning and development opportunities to grow your skills and career.
Referral Programme: An attractive referral program to reward you for recommending talented people to our team.
JobRad leasing made easy: Save up to 40% on your dream bike – with insurance and checkups sponsored by simplesurance.
Team Spirit: Celebrate with us through regular company events and in-office gatherings with tasty food and a fun atmosphere!
Culture of Growth: We have an open feedback culture and a solution-oriented environment, with an amazing and caring team dedicated to growth and improvement.
Explore Our HQ: Conveniently located in the heart of Berlin, our headquarters offers easy access via U-Bahn and S-Bahn.
Curious to know more? - Check out what else we offer here.
For Your Application
No matter your background, we encourage you to apply, and Treveka Spencer, our Talent Acquisition Manager, is thrilled to review your application. At simplesurance, we are committed to providing equal opportunities to all.
„Never stop playing!”

As a
Talent Strategy Intern
at Consultport, you will be responsible for attracting, retaining, and developing top talent. As we are rapidly growing, this is an extremely critical aspect of Consultport.
Tasks
Your Mission
Talent Strategy

people person

ownership

title: Internship / Working Student - Talent Acquisition
full_description:
We are CARIAD, the automotive software company of the Volkswagen Group. Our teams build automotive software platforms and digital customer functions for iconic brands like Audi, Volkswagen, and Porsche – supporting the Volkswagen Group in becoming the leading automotive technology company. With CARIDIANS in Germany, the USA, China, Estonia, and India, we are transforming automotive mobility for everyone.
Join us and be part of this exciting journey!
YOUR TEAM
We’re looking for a motivated intern or working student to join our Talent Acquisition team and support us across Recruiting, Employer Branding, and Talent Programs. In this role, you’ll gain hands-on experience in a wide range of talent acquisition and development activities and become a valued part of a team that thrives on flexibility, collaboration, and service-oriented solutions.
Our diverse and dynamic team of 15 colleagues brings together experienced recruiters and forward‑thinking talent marketing experts. Together, we drive CARIAD’s mission to attract, engage, and onboard top talent — from students to experienced professionals shaping the future of automotive software.
What You Will Do
Support our Talent Acquisition teams in their daily operations across recruiting, employer branding, and talent programs.
Create, maintain, and publish engaging job postings on relevant platforms.
Manage the career inbox and ensure timely, professional communication with candidates.
Take ownership of planning and organizing the monthly onboarding event for new colleagues.
Contribute to data analysis, reporting, and various ad‑hoc tasks that help drive operational excellence.
Support Talent Programs and contribute to cross‑functional initiatives aimed at continuously improving our processes.
Assist with university marketing activities — from planning and coordination to on‑site support and follow‑up.
Help optimize and evaluate offboarding processes for interns and working students.
Share your ideas to continuously enhance our recruiting processes, the candidate journey, and internal workflows.
Who You Are
You are an enrolled student in Business Administration, Human Resources, Psychology, or a related field.
You bring initial experience — and genuine enthusiasm — for recruiting and current talent acquisition trends.
You have an open, engaging personality and strong communication skills that help you build trust with candidates and spark their interest in CARIAD.
You have good to very good Excel skills; experience with strategic reporting is a plus.
You work proactively, enjoy taking ownership, and communicate clearly in a dynamic environment.
You are highly organized and able to prioritize tasks effectively.
You are fluent in both German and English.
NICE TO KNOW
Remote work options within Germany
Working student position
Duration: 6 months
20 hours/week, up to 35 hours/week during semester breaks
Salary: €17.80/hour
Internship:
Duration: 3 - 6 months
35 h/week
Salary: 13,90€/hour
At CARIAD, we embrace individuality and diversity because we believe our differences make us stronger. We actively seek to build teams with a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Our goal is to create an environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute. If you need assistance with your application due to a disability, please reach out to us at careers@cariad.technology - we are happy to support you.

title: Manager Marketing Retail Flagship
full_description:
SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy and all genders are welcome. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.
YOUR MISSION:
Develop and implement comprehensive retail marketing plans that align with brand strategy and commercial objectives.
Tailor in‑store campaigns, promotions, and product launch activations to drive consumer engagement and increase sales.
Manage the flagship store’s marketing calendar to ensure timely and consistent rollout of all brand initiatives.
Analyze customer behavior, market trends, and competitive activities to inform retail marketing tactics and identify opportunities for improvement.
Partner with Visual Merchandising teams to ensure in‑store storytelling, signage, and displays reflect brand guidelines and deliver a premium experience.
Oversee the production of POS materials, digital content, and event assets while ensuring brand consistency across all touchpoints.
Coordinate campaign development and execution with external vendors and agencies when needed.
Collaborate closely with Retail Operations, PR, Sales, and Brand teams to maintain alignment and share insights for continuous improvement.
Support store leadership in integrating marketing activities that enhance overall retail performance.
Manage and allocate the marketing budget responsibly, and track campaign performance to optimize future initiatives.
YOUR TALENT:
Experience with 3–5 years in retail marketing, brand activation, events, or in‑store communication—preferably within fashion, sports, or lifestyle environments.
Hands-on experience supporting in‑store activations, retail campaigns, and event coordination.
Exposure to working with Visual Merchandising, Retail Operations, PR, and Brand teams in an execution‑focused capacity.
Understanding of consumer behavior, retail trends, and in‑store engagement tactics.
Experience coordinating, budget tracking, reporting, and evaluating campaign performance.
Strong execution and coordination skills to support frequent in‑store activations, events, and retail campaigns.
Excellent organizational skills, including managing timelines, production assets, logistics, and vendor coordination.
Creative mindset with the ability to support storytelling, POS execution, and brand‑aligned retail moments.
Good communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross‑functional teams and external partners.
Comfortable handling event logistics such as materials, shipments, guest lists, and onsite support.
Detail‑oriented with the ability to monitor campaign performance, prepare basic reports, and support continuous improvement.
Ability to multitask in a fast‑paced retail environment with frequent activations and changing priorities.
PUMA supports over 21,000 employees across 120+ countries. The PUMA Group owns the brand PUMA, Cobra Golf and stichd, and is headquartered in Herzogenaurach, Germany.
PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.

title: INTERNSHIP - IR - MARKETING & PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT - FUNDRAISING - BERLIN  - February 2026
full_description:
INTERNSHIP - IR - MARKETING & PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT - FUNDRAISING - BERLIN - February 2026
Eurazeo
Eurazeo is a leading global investment group with €37.4bn in diversified assets under management, including €28bn on behalf of institutional and private clients through its private equity, private debt, real estate and infrastructure strategies.
The Group supports around 600 companies, leveraging the commitment of its over 400 employees, its sector expertise, its privileged access to global markets via 14 offices in Europe, Asia and the United States, and its responsible approach to value creation based on growth.
The company's institutional and family shareholding structure, and its solid financial structure, ensure its long-term viability.
Position description
This internship is part of the Marketing and Product Development team within the Investor Relations department, which leads the Group's fundraising activities.
The team, composed of 13 professionals across Paris, London, and Berlin (with Paris as the main hub), combines product expertise with RFP and mandate execution.
On the product side, the team acts as the Group's in-house product expert, with a deep understanding of fund positioning, LP expectations, and product development across both institutional and wealth channels. The team is responsible for defining and articulating the Group's strategies and translating them into clear and compelling marketing and fundraising materials.
On the RFP and mandates side, the team manages and responds to all LP-driven requests, including RFPs, due diligence questionnaires, and mandates, in close coordination with investment and internal teams.
The role is based in Berlin, working closely with the local team while being fully integrated into the international platform.
Job Responsibilities
The Investor Relations - Marketing & Product Development intern will support fundraising efforts across all investment strategies, notably through:
Creating and updating marketing materials (fund presentations, teasers, fundraising documents, profiles, pitchbooks)
Maintaining fund listing databases
Preparing market analyses and competitive intelligence
Coordinating and responding to due diligence questionnaires and RFPs
Managing and updating fundraising datarooms
Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills
Gap year or final-year student from a top-tier business school or leading institution
A first professional experience in a demanding environment, ideally with significant responsibilities, is a plus (Private Equity, Investor Relations, Investment Banking, or Consulting)
Autonomous and well-organized, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and take initiative
Demonstrated rigor, commitment, and strong analytical skills, with a solid understanding of the Private Equity fund ecosystem
Excellent analytical, quantitative, and interpretative skills
Ability to thrive in a dynamic and collaborative work environment
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word). Familiarity with other tools/platforms is a plus (Intralinks, Loopio, Preqin, PitchBook, etc.)
Must be legally eligible to work in Germany.
Eurazeo guarantees equal treatment for candidates and employees, regardless of their social and ethnic origin, age, place of birth, gender, religion, education, disability, etc.. Our company is committed to ensuring equal opportunities in the recruitment of our future employees, their professional development, their compensation, etc..

title: E-Commerce Management Trainee (m/f/d)
full_description:
Your Responsibilities:
Position Overview:
As an E-com Management Trainee, you will be guided by your mentor to learn and practice the operation of Amazon and other e-commerce platforms step by step, covering the whole process from product uploading, content optimisation, inventory management to data analysis and customer feedback management. Through systematic training and hands-on practice, you will grow into a business backbone who can independently manage specific Amazon categories and further expand to other e-commerce platforms and business areas.
Initial Stage (Learning & Collaboration):
Assist with product launches and listing optimization on e-commerce platforms.
Support the preparation of data reports and performance dashboards.
Collaborate in preparing customer price lists and quotations.
Assist with inventory management and demand forecasting.
Support return analysis and improvement measures.
Track and analyze sales data, conversion rates, and advertising performance, and provide optimization suggestions.
Assist with KOL outreach and communication.
Later Stage (Independent Responsibility):
Independently manage designated product categories on Amazon, developing and executing sales and operation strategies and taking direct responsibility for sales performance and profitability.
Independently manage other e-commerce platform customers or channels.
Participate in New Product Launch and Market Entry (GTM) projects and develop local market strategies.
Continuously analyse business data and optimise operational processes to drive sales growth.
Career Development Path
We provide you with a clear career advancement path to help you grow into a manager in the e-commerce field: E-commerce Management Trainee -> Junior Key Account Manager-> Key Account Manager-> Senior Key Account Manager-> E-com Director.
Your Profile:
Bachelor’s degree from a top-tier university; A Master’s degree from a top university in Germany is highly desirable.
Solid understanding of business administration; relevant internships or work experience are an advantage.
Strong learning ability and analytical skills, particularly in data analysis.
Fluent in English and Chinese; good command of German both written and spoken, business fluent would be preferrable.
What we offer:
An independent role with growing responsibilities in an innovative, and market-leading international company.
A friendly and motivated team.
Partial home office possible.
An attractive salary with target-related OTE bonus.
28-31 annual holidays, increasing with company tenure.
Company pension scheme (betriebliche Altersvorsorge).
Good incentive plan including monthly food voucher, voucher for birthday, presents for on- and offboarding, marriage, childbirth, company anniversary, International Women’s Day, and so on.
Employee referral award.
Regular team events (monthly tea time, quarterly team building, Christmas party, etc.).
Ergonomic office chairs and height-adjustable workplaces.
Modern office with free parking places.
Free drinks and good tea and coffee.
Employee discounts on our wide range of our products.
About Us
Headquartered in the United States, TP-Link is a global provider of reliable networking devices and smart home products, consistently ranked as the world’s top provider of Wi-Fi devices. The company is committed to delivering innovative products that enhance people’s lives through faster, more reliable connectivity. With a commitment to excellence, TP-Link serves customers in over 170 countries and continues to grow its global footprint.
With a proven heritage of stability, performance, and value, TP-Link has curated a portfolio of products that meet the networking needs of all individuals. Now, as the connected lifestyle continues to evolve, the company is expanding today to exceed the demands of tomorrow.
TP-Link Deutschland started in April 2009 in Germany, housing the Sales and Marketing team for DACH region, and providing support and central warehouse for the WEU region. Through our renowned distribution, online and retail partners, we distribute a comprehensive range of award-winning SOHO products (WLAN, DSL, Powerline, repeaters, UMTS / LTE, print servers, IP cameras, smart home devices) and SMB products (Switch, router, SFP modules, media converters, network adapters, video surveillance) and so on.
More at: http://www.tp-link.de.

Meet the Team
Join our team in Munich and help us drive success. Whether it’s preparing internal and external communication, B2B marketing and product materials, managing CRM content, or organizing events, we collaborate with different internal teams and external partners to keep our messaging clear, consistent, and aligned with our brand. If you have a creative eye, a passion for design, and curious about e-mobility, this is a great place to build your skills and contribute to meaningful projects. Join our team in Munich and help us shape how e-mobility is seen, communicated, and experienced.
Make an Impact by:
Designing B2B marketing materials such as one-pagers, infographics, flyers, brochures, and short-form video assets that are visually impactful and on-brand.
Supporting product marketing initiatives by translating product features and value propositions into clear, compelling visual narratives for B2B audiences.
Managing content creation for white-label products, while ensuring brand consistency and accuracy across welcome packages, websites, and partner-facing materials.
Developing and editing external communications across platforms including newsletters, landing pages, and the DCS intranet, with a strong visual and editorial eye.
Creating and refining PowerPoint presentations for internal and external meetings, ensuring they are polished, consistent, and visually engaging.
Collaborating cross-functionally with internal stakeholders and external agencies, providing clear creative briefs and maintaining smooth communication.
Supporting event preparation: from promotional materials and booth designs to post-event content and reports.

Fluent in English (business proficiency); German skills are a plus.
Strong design and graphics skills, with hands-on experience in tools like Figma, Canva, Adobe Illustrator, or InDesign.
A natural eye for visual detail, layout, and typography, and a talent for structuring and presenting information clearly.
Genuine interest in product marketing and B2B communication, with enthusiasm for creating materials that drive business impact.
Strong ability to work with AI-tools, while staying in the driver’s seat.
Self-motivated, collaborative, and comfortable contributing in cross-functional teams.
Highly organized, able to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

title: UX Designer (all genders) - Fleet Handling
full_description:
Join us as a UX Designer (all genders) in our Fleet Handling team (parental leave cover - 12 months) and help shape the future of autonomous mobility!
We are looking for a talented and experienced individual to fill
a UX Designer (parental leave cover 12 months)
position.
In this role, you will be part of a multidisciplinary product team that owns multiple services, not visible to riders, but on an operational level, behind the scenes.
As a team, we empower MOIA’s autonomous operations by providing a single, reliable source of truth for fleet handling. Our mission is to empower operators and hub teams with a clear, reliable, and actionable view of their fleet. As a UX Designer, you will improve the existing product from a UX perspective and will drive forward discoveries and identify new potential topics in collaboration with the product manager and engineers.
Our Design Team
In addition to the product team, you will be part of the design team at MOIA. We are a diverse team of UX Designers, Product Designers, and UX Researchers with all different kinds of strengths, backgrounds, and personalities. We always support each other and strongly believe that a team works best as a collective. As the design team, we pride ourselves on always bringing in the interests of our customers into our interdisciplinary teams and products.
What you will do
Interdisciplinary team – work closely with engineers and product managers to define both the long-term strategy and the short-term tactics for our upcoming initiatives.
Understand together – partner with UX Research and Product Design.
Embrace our product – analyze and understand the array of technical constraints, user goals, and business requirements that shape our products
What will help you to fulfill your role
The right person will be comfortable in an “all hands on deck” environment, loves solving problems, is excited to work in high-performance teams.
Expert in UX design and complex discovery topics.
Experienced in user research that surfaces authentic and unbiased insights.
Ability to adapt to changing environments.
You can be convincing, when necessary, about your designs, but are also able to find compromises that are best for our customers and business.
You look at your design as an iterative process towards customer happiness.
You feel home using a design system and help push it even further.
Deep understanding of web applications.
An excellent portfolio showcasing your design work, style, and interests.
Business fluent communication in English.
We welcome applicants from diverse back
g
rounds — even if you don’t meet every requirement. If you’re excited about the role and MOIA’s mission, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Product Manager
full_description:
Product Manager/Sales Manager - Oil & Gas Sector - Compression Technology - Europe/Middle East, Hybrid - Permanent - Competitive Salary & Bonus Scheme - English-Speaking
One of our best clients is searching for an experienced engineer with strong technical knowledge of compressors/piston compressors to join their Aftermarket Sales team.
Our client operates globally across the oil and gas sector (including hydrogen) and has experienced consistent growth over the last decade. The feedback we have received from the candidates we have already placed with them has been extremely positive, and my Director and I had the chance to visit their headquarters in Germany last year to meet them in person.
For this position, our client is looking for a specialist in compression technology to maintain and service their existing accounts, strengthen their client base, and provide valuable training to their workforce. The position does not require being based in Germany — our client is happy for candidates to be located anywhere within the EMEA region (Europe, Middle East, Africa).
The role also involves overseeing the entire sales region across EMEA and India. As such, there is a great deal of flexibility in determining your own strategies and schedule. All travel expenses will be fully covered, and our client is willing to offer a highly competitive and flexible salary package.
Key Responsibilities:
Manage the full lifecycle of aftermarket wear parts for piston compressors (e.g., piston rings, packings, valves, rider bands, gaskets, sealing components).
Analyse product performance, pricing, market trends, and competitor offerings to ensure a competitive and profitable portfolio.
Develop and maintain technical documentation, product specifications, and lifecycle strategies.
Identify opportunities for product improvements, standardisation, and cost optimisation.
Support global and regional sales teams with technical expertise, pricing strategies, and solution recommendations.
Serve as the technical point of contact for customers regarding wear‑part performance, compatibility, and optimisation.
Key Qualifications:
Technical background in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field; additional commercial experience is a plus.
Professional experience in reciprocating compressors, rotating equipment, or aftermarket spare parts.
Strong understanding of wear parts, maintenance cycles, material behaviour, and compressor performance.
Commercial mindset with experience in pricing, sales support, or product management.
Strong communication skills, customer orientation, and the ability to collaborate with cross‑functional teams.
Fluent in English; German is an advantage but not essential.
Company Benefits
Bonus structure that increases annually
Full healthcare coverage
Relocation assistance
30 days of paid annual leave
Excellent work–life balance and working environment, including regular company events and socials
If this position is of interest, please reach out to me directly on LinkedIn or via email (joe.brazier@g2recruitment.com - please let me know you saw the posting here if so) with some available time slots, and we can set up an introductory call where I can share more details.
Alternatively, please feel free to pass this on to any friends or colleagues who may be interested.
Interviews are taking place over the next two weeks. The process consists of two stages: a 30‑minute Teams call with the Managing Director, followed by a fully paid visit to their headquarters in Germany for the final stage.

Manager / Project Manager (m/f/d) - ILS

The position offers an exciting opportunity to lead complex projects, develop innovative support concepts, and work alongside a talented team committed to excellence in customer support and logistical analysis.

A successful degree in aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, industrial engineering, or a related field.

Location: Over the Lake Constance region in Germany

Entry Level: Suitable for professionals with relevant experience or advanced graduates with proven capabilities
Start Date: As soon as possible

title: Manager/Project Manager (m/f/d) ILS
full_description:
Manager / Project Manager (m/f/d) - Integrated Life Cycle Support
About the Organisation
Our Client is a leading entity within the defence and aerospace industry, renowned for innovative solutions and technological excellence. They foster a dynamic and inclusive workplace culture that rewards expertise, promotes professional growth, and values collaboration. With a reputation built on precision and reliability, they are committed to pushing the boundaries of engineering and support services in a global market.
Role Overview
In response to strategic growth initiatives, our Client is seeking a highly skilled Manager or Project Manager specialising in Integrated Life Cycle Support (ILCS). This pivotal role is integral to advancing international projects that underpin the maintenance and support of military systems. The position offers an exciting opportunity to lead complex projects, develop innovative support concepts, and work alongside a talented team committed to excellence in customer support and logistical analysis.
What You Will Do
Oversee ILCS projects within the Customer Support division, ensuring seamless coordination among subcontractors and internal teams across multiple countries.
Lead and manage work packages related to the Integrated Life Cycle Support for international defence projects.
Develop and implement comprehensive support strategies for defence systems, guiding teams in conducting critical logistical evaluations.
Prepare technical proposals and participate in negotiations, ensuring solutions meet customer requirements and project specifications.
Present project updates and technical results effectively to partners, stakeholders, and clients in a multicultural environment.
Foster strong relationships with clients, subcontractors, and project team members, operating with professionalism and assertiveness.
What You Bring
A successful degree in aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, industrial engineering, or a related field.
Extensive experience in Integrated Life Cycle Support or Customer Support within the defence or aerospace sectors.
Proven track record in managing military systems maintenance, preferably in an international context.
Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management abilities.
Willingness to travel internationally and represent our Client professionally across borders.
Fluent spoken and written English; additional languages are advantageous.
Additional Information
Location: Over the Lake Constance region in Germany
Employment Type: Permanent, full-time position
Entry Level: Suitable for professionals with relevant experience or advanced graduates with proven capabilities
Start Date: As soon as possible

title: Mandatory Internship - Data Analytics and Data Visualization with Power BI - REF7454Z
full_description:
Company Description
Since its spin-off in September 2025 AUMOVIO continues the business of the former Continental group sector Automotive as an independent company. The technology and electronics company offers a wide-ranging portfolio that makes mobility safe, exciting, connected, and autonomous. This includes sensor solutions, displays, braking and comfort systems as well as comprehensive expertise in software, architecture platforms, and assistance systems for software-defined vehicles. In the fiscal year 2024 the business areas, which now belong to AUMOVIO, generated sales of 19.6 billion Euro. The company is headquartered in Frankfurt, Germany and has about 87.000 employees in more than 100 locations worldwide.
Job Description
We are looking for an intern (m/f/diverse) to actively support our team at the Frankfurt location from May 15th, 2026 for a period of 6 months.
Your Tasks Include
Creation and maintenance of Power BI dashboards and reports for visualizing company data
Assisting in data analysis and preparation from various sources
Collaborating with different departments to understand and implement their data visualization requirements
Conducting ad-hoc analyses and providing insights to support decision-making
Supporting the optimization and automation of existing reports and dashboards
Qualifications
You’re wondering whether you’re a good fit for the internship in Data Analytics and Data Visualization? Here are some key qualifications we’re looking for:
Student of a technical or commercial course such as computer science, business informatics, business administration or a comparable academic degree
Well versed in MS Office programs and PowerBI
IC++ knowledge desirable
Basic knowledge of German and fluent English language skills (written and spoken)
Quick comprehension and analytical thinking
Accuracy and strong communication skills
Please remember to upload your current enrollment certificate, your latest transcript, and an excerpt from the current study regulations regarding the completion of a mandatory internship, as these are essential for processing your application!
If necessary, please submit a valid residence permit and your work permit, including the supplementary sheet.
Applications from severely handicapped people are welcome.
Additional Information
The opportunity to gain practical experience in data analysis and business intelligence
Insights into various company departments and the chance to work on real projects
Steep learning curve and the opportunity to contribute to current digitalization topics
Collegial cooperation in a hybrid working model (up to 50% home office)
The opportunity to write a Bachelor/Master thesis at AUMOVIO
If you see yourself in our position and are interested in working with us on exciting projects, then apply now and become part of our team!
Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging are important to us and make our company strong and successful. We offer equal opportunities to everyone -regardless of age, gender, nationality, cultural background, disability, religion, ideology or sexual orientation
Ready to take your career to the next level? The future of mobility isn’t just anyone’s job. Make it yours!
Join AUMOVIO. Own What’s Next.

Applying for a job at PUMA is easy and all genders are welcome. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.
YOUR MISSION:
At PUMA, Digital & Technology enables how our teams collaborate, work, and innovate globally. As
Junior Project Manager Business Supporting Solutions
, you will support the coordination, rollout, and continuous improvement of digital solutions used across PUMA – from Digital Workplace tools to business‑supporting applications. You will work closely with senior project managers, solution owners, architects, and global stakeholders, contributing to structured delivery, adoption, and stable operations of digital solutions in a dynamic, international environment.
Your key responsibilities will include:
Supporting and coordinating digital initiatives and projects across Digital Workplace & Business Supporting Solutions, in alignment with senior project and solution leads
Acting as an ambassador for digital solutions, supporting adoption across areas such as collaboration, automation, AI‑enabled solutions, and business applications
Supporting global user communities, key user networks, and Centers of Excellence to drive knowledge sharing and best practices
Assisting in the coordination of internal and external delivery partners to ensure quality, timelines, and scope of solution initiatives
Collaborating closely with project managers, solution owners, solution architects, and other internal IT and business stakeholders
Supporting change management activities related to the rollout and adoption of digital solutions across PUMA locations worldwide
Providing 2nd‑level support for assigned digital solutions, including incident coordination, issue analysis, and continuous improvement support
Supporting documentation, reporting, and transparency across projects and solutions.
YOUR TALENT:
Education & Background
Completed vocational training, apprenticeship, or degree in Information Technology, Business Informatics, Digital & Technology, or a related field
Initial professional experience or strong practical exposure to IT or digital solutions (e.g. internships, working student roles, apprenticeships, or project work).
Technical & Analytical Skills
Strong interest in digital solutions and modern enterprise IT landscapes
Basic understanding of SaaS solutions, system integrations, and digital platforms
Familiarity with Microsoft technologies (e.g. Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Azure concepts) is an advantage
Ability to understand, document, and structure technical solutions and business processes.
Project & Collaboration Skills
Interest in project coordination, solution ownership, and structured delivery of digital initiatives
Ability to capture requirements and support their translation into technical and operational solutions
Structured, reliable, and solution‑oriented working style.
Communication & Mindset
Strong communication skills with the ability to interact confidently with business and IT stakeholders
Ability to explain technical topics in a clear and understandable way
High level of ownership, responsibility, and willingness to grow within a long‑term role
Team player with the ability to work effectively in a global, multicultural environment.
This job opportunity will be available in full-time or part-time.
PUMA supports over 21,000 employees across 120+ countries. The PUMA Group owns the brand PUMA, Cobra Golf and stichd, and is headquartered in Herzogenaurach, Germany.
PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.

seca is the global market leader in medical measuring systems and precision scales, trusted by healthcare professionals in more than 110 countries. For over 185 years, our name has stood for the highest quality, innovation, and absolute reliability – and we are shaping the future of connected, data-driven health solutions.
At our headquarters in Hamburg, more than 300 employees develop intelligent solutions that combine precise hardware, smart algorithms, and digital platforms. We grow by acting fast, valuing ideas, and turning innovation into real-world impact.
We’re expanding our Product Management team
at our headquarters in Hamburg
and are looking for a
Product Manager for Strategic Partnerships (m/f/d)
to join our
Body Composition Solutions
team. In this role, you will shape joint value propositions with strategic partners and translate customer needs, partner capabilities, and product strategy into scalable, customer-centric solutions that create lasting value for both healthcare and fitness professionals and for seca.
Your mission:
Your key responsibilities will include:
Shape and execute partnership strategy
Evaluate and prioritize strategic partnership opportunities in the medical (e.g. digital health ecosystems, other medical device manufacturers) and fitness (e.g. gym solution providers) segment that complement our product roadmap, value propositions and growth objectives.
Shape the strategic direction for partnerships by translating business goals into clear partnership propositions and joint value creation models.

full_description:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers. The future won’t wait... why should you? Join us and make a difference. Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow. Are you in?
Your Role
In this position you’ll be able to join the ATV (automotive) team while supporting to ensure the smooth operation in product development, collaborating with internal and external teams, and maintaining organization through reporting, access rights management and first level tool support.
Key responsibilities in your new role
Keep up to date: Maintaining of knowledge database with textual and graphical content especially in Tableau. Also, support in the access rights management
Reliable Work: Maintaining the configuration setup of product development project data
Shape the future: Interact with the internal team, as well as the external developer teams
Keep the Overview: Setting up and sustaining weekly reports of large data using dedicated reporting tools
First Level Support: Being contacted by the team in regards to common tool questions and needs (Jama, Jira, Tableau, Windchill etc.)
Your Profile
Qualifications And Skills To Help You Succeed
Study field: You are having good academic credentials or at least three semesters successfully completed in Business Administration, IT, Physics or Engineering
Interests: You are highly motivated to learn about Change management activities and Tools with a high degree of self-initiative
Way of working: You consider yourself a highly organized, structured, analytical and motivated individual
Personality: You consider yourself a team player with a desire to work in an international team, possess excellent communication skills
Experience: You bring practical experience in setup / usage /maintenance of Reporting systems and Databases (e.g. Tableau, Access, MySQL, MS Office…). You have already gained first work experience through internships, student jobs, etc.
Language skills: You have very good command of English skills, both written and spoken. German knowledge is a plus
Please attach the following documents to your application:
CV in English
Certificate of enrollment at university
Latest grades transcript (not older than 6 months)
High school report
Important information:
Working part-time: The focus is on studies. That’s why working as a student employee during lecture period is limited to a maximum of 20 hours per week.
Proper students (according to the German law) are welcome: To work as a student employee with us, you must be enrolled at a university and not have completed all of your exams or modules for your degree programme. You must not be in a semester of leave. We look forward to welcoming you to our team for at least 6 months.
You should live close to the site: For good collaboration, it is important to us that you can come to the office regularly to integrate to the team.

Mafalda Porto

full_description:
Schaeffler is a dynamic global technology company and its success has been a result of its entrepreneurial spirit and long history of private ownership. Does that sound interesting to you? As a partner to all of the major automobile manufacturers, as well as key players in the aerospace and industrial sectors, we offer you many development opportunities.
The basic requirement for an internship at Schaeffler is proof of enrollment at the time of the internship.
This position can be filled immediately for a period of 3 to 6 months.
Your Key Responsibilities
Support in the preparation of marketing concepts for focus topics (e.g. Digitalization, Technology & Innovations, Hydrogen, Humanoids)
Support the creation and revision of marketing materials
Assist in the development and execution of global marketing campaigns
Creation and revisions of presentations and templates for campaigns
Support in global project management with international stakeholders
Collaboration and support in Brand Training Projects
Conduct desk research and analyze trends to assist in strategic planning, reporting
Support in maintenance of Microsoft Sharepoint / Intranet
Your Qualifications
Currently pursuing a degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Industrial Psychology or a related field
Excellent written and spoken German and English skills
Proficient in MS-Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, etc.)
Self-initiative, creativity, and a hands-on mentality
Communication & teamwork skills
Our Offering
Attractive compensation and flexible working hours
Considerable amount of training courses via the Schaeffler Academy
Initiatives that support both the mental and physical well-being, e.g. via the Schaeffler Health Coach App
Opportunity to network in an international environment through various networking events (e.g. student get-together and Top Students Program)
An appreciative working atmosphere
A subsidized company restaurant
A wide range of employee benefits which includes, inter alia, corporate benefits
As a global company with employees around the world, it is important to us that we treat each other with respect and value all ideas and perspectives. By appreciating our differences, we inspire creativity and drive innovation. In this way, we contribute to sustainable value creation for our stakeholders and society as a whole. Together, we advance how the world moves.
Exciting assignments and outstanding development opportunities await you because we impact the future with innovation. We look forward to your application.
