title: Junior Marketing Manager
full_description:
ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions is part of the ASSA ABLOY Group, who are the global leader in access solutions. Every day, we reimagine how people move through a safer, more open world with ease. If you’ve ever walked through an automatic door, stayed in a hotel, or gone through passport control, you’ve probably used one of our products or services. We have operations in over 70 countries, with over 52,000 colleagues around the world.
Marketing Manager Junior – Traka DACH
Global Solutions GmbH, Germany
Traka DACH, part of the world-leading ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions, is now looking for its next key contributor in marketing!
Do you want to help strengthen our brand presence and create high-quality B2B marketing content for one of the world’s most innovative security companies? Are you someone who enjoys creative work, thrives in a fast-paced environment in a small team, and has a passion for digital B2B marketing and communication? Then you might be the one we’re looking for – we look forward to receiving your application!
About Traka And ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions
Traka provides intelligent key and asset management solutions, both hardware and software, that help organizations improve security, efficiency, and accountability. Our systems are trusted across a wide range of industries, including automotive retailers, facility management, logistics, hospitals, data centers, and critical infrastructure.
Traka is part of ASSA ABLOY and has a strong and growing presence in the DACH region. To further strengthen our marketing capabilities and support the continued expansion of the Traka and KEYper brands, we are now looking for a Marketing Manager Junior based in Germany.
Introduction
As a Junior Marketing Manager at Traka DACH, you will support B2B marketing activities across Germany, working closely with the sales team and the EMEIA/UK marketing organization. This hands-on role covers campaigns, digital marketing, website content and event coordination, and reports to the General Manager Traka DACH.
You will help strengthen the marketing presence of Traka and KEYper in the DACH region, using tools such as Salesforce, Adobe Creative Suite or Canva, LinkedIn Campaign Manager and marketing analytics platforms. In addition to the DACH focus, you will also support selected marketing initiatives for the Nordic region, offering exposure to international collaboration and cross-regional projects.
Main Responsibilities
Support execution of the Traka DACH marketing plan aligned with EMEIA
Support social, paid media, SEO/SEM and LinkedIn campaigns
Create content for social, web, brochures and sales materials
Localize marketing toolkits and materials
Analyze campaign and CRM performance
Assist with KPIs, dashboards and reporting
Drive lead generation across the funnel
Provide go-to-market materials for the sales team
Coordinate events, trade shows, webinars and demos
Maintain the Traka DACH website (AEM)
Support social media scheduling and engagement
Update or design sales materials in Adobe/Canva
Perform admin tasks: databases, reports and budget tracking
Who You Are
You are a structured, creative and solutions-oriented person with a strong interest in marketing, communication and digital channels. You enjoy collaborating with colleagues and external agencies across countries, contributing ideas and supporting the sales team. You work proactively, manage multiple tasks confidently and communicate clearly with a positive, team-driven mindset.
Requirements
1–3 years of experience in B2B marketing, communications or a similar role (experience in technology, security, IoT, SaaS or industrial solutions is a plus)
Proven experience in digital marketing, content creation and campaign activation
Strong analytical mindset with demonstrated experience in market or campaign analysis
Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop) or Canva
Good planning and coordination skills; event experience is an advantage
Basic understanding of analytics, CRM systems or web CMS platforms (AEM is a plus)
Excellent communication skills, written and spoken English and German
Demonstrated ability to collaborate cross-functionally and internationally
Proactive, structured and able to manage several projects simultaneously
A valid driver’s license is an advantage
We believe you have a bachelor’s degree in marketing, Communications, Business Administration or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Some travel within the EMEIA region may be required.
Location
The position is based in Germany. Hybrid work is possible. Regional travel within the DACH area will be required for events and exhibitions.
More information and application
We welcome your application as soon as possible! We apply continuous selection, which means the position may be filled before the final application date.
Please note that we do not accept applications via email or post.
Submit your application through our online application link.
We are the ASSA ABLOY Group
Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.
As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.
As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Compliance Intern
full_description:
Please note that this position is based in Berlin, Germany.
THE BEST WORK OF YOUR CAREER
Trade Republic is the largest savings platform in Europe - we operate in 18 countries, serving +10 million customers who trusted us with over 150B in assets. But we're striving for more.
We have a bold mission to empower everyone to build wealth with easy, safe, and free access to financial systems. You will have the opportunity to grow your career by collaborating with a team of outstanding talents and state of the art technology to build a lasting, positive future for millions.
WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
The Compliance Assurance Function is responsible for monitoring and reviewing the processes and controls established at Trade Republic which ensure compliance with banking regulations. This includes the oversight of complaints management and oversight of all communication with the German Banking Regulator BaFin regarding Complaints.
Conduct independent reviews of processes and controls regarding investments (WpHG), anti-money laundering (GWG) and complaints
Collaborate with internal teams in obtaining relevant information regarding processes and controls
Research our internal systems to gather relevant evidence for samples checks
Apply SQL queries in Snowflake to gather data
What We're Looking For
Enrolled or completed a university degree (study focus in the field of economics, business studies, law, computer science, mathematics, physics, humanities or other relevant fields)
Highly motivated to learn about regulatory requirements / Compliance in the financial industry
Initial experience in financial services or advisory would be an advantage
Interest in banking, finance, capital markets, and their regulatory frameworks
Independent working attitude with adherence to deadlines
Effective communication skills, dedication and strong organisational abilities
Proactive with an open-minded attitude, unafraid of new challenges
WHY YOU SHOULD APPLY NOW
Our culture rewards ownership, excellence, and high energy. We care deeply about outcomes and hold each other accountable - we're here to win and fix one of the largest challenges Europeans face - closing the pension gap and democratising wealth. If this gets you fired up, reach out!
We believe it's our team's varied identities and backgrounds that make us sharper and stronger. We're committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected and has equal opportunity to thrive in their careers. For any questions on DEI during the interview process, reach out to your recruitment partner.

Advance your career with exciting professional opportunities in our thriving company with a startup feel

Use your unique vision to inspire clients and realize their business processes and strategies in apps and software.

Take the lead on implementing your software vision with internal and external development teams and ensure timely delivery as well as meet cost and quality expectations.
About You
You have a bachelor’s or master’s degree (business, computer science or a related field) and one to three years of professional experience in IT consulting, software development or product management.
You have knowledge of and are enthusiastic about technology trends and digital topics, including cloud technologies, app development, and AI concepts.
You have proven record of first-hand experience as a (technical) project manager.

You are familiar with software development concepts (e.g., microservices vs. monolith), methodologies (e.g., Scrum, test driven development, etc.), and ideally have experience writing code.
You have refined problem-solving skills to creatively translate business needs into digital solutions.
You have strong interpersonal and communication skills and proactively, reliably, and enthusiastically work with clients, consultants, and developers.
You are fluent in English (proficiency in additional languages, especially German, is a major advantage).
Ideally you have a good understanding or even hands-on experience with some of the following topics: CI/CD, relational databases, data integrations, programming, devops and Cloud infrastructure.

title: Product Manager for Bonsai (Innovation Hub)
full_description:
At JetBrains, code is our passion. Ever since we started, back in 2000, we have strived to make the strongest, most effective developer tools on earth. By automating routine checks and corrections, our tools speed up production, freeing developers to grow, discover, and create.
Bonsai is an innovative project within JetBrains' Innovation Hub. Its aim is to help developers keep AI agents aligned and under control, focusing only on what really matters in the development workflow. Our goal is to build an infrastructure for AI-powered spec-driven development that helps teams ship complex systems efficiently, while keeping outcomes trustworthy, auditable, and flexible as requirements and code evolve.
We already have a working prototype and are preparing an Alpha. We’re looking for a Product Manager to work with our team as we move from prototype to product, validating developer needs, sharpening positioning, and setting early priorities.
This Will Be An Exciting Opportunity If You
Want to create something new.
Care about building trust in AI.
Enjoy zero-to-one product development.
In This Role, You Will
Talk to developers and run discovery interviews to understand real workflows and pain points.
Define the product direction, including the ICP, key scenarios, and what we build first.
Track the market and competitors to inform priorities.
We will be happy to have you on our team if you:
Have at least one year of experience as a Product Manager or in a role with the equivalent level of ownership and responsibility – for example, leading discovery and delivery end to end.
Have a strong technical mindset, ideally, with production coding experience.
Are comfortable working with ambiguity and enjoy turning uncertainty into a plan through discovery.
We Would Be Especially Thrilled If You
Have zero-to-one product development experience (early product discovery, shaping a new product, design partners, first real adoption).
Have experience with developer tools, IDEs, workflow products, or developer productivity platforms.
Are familiar with or curious about AI-assisted development, AI agents, and how teams integrate them into real systems.
We process the data provided in your job application in accordance with the Recruitment Privacy Policy.

title: Intern in Integrated Process & Mathematical Solutions (all Genders)
full_description:
Where do you want to go? What do you want to achieve? How would you like to get involved? The choice is yours and we will support you on your way. At Bayer, multi-talented people and specialists, visionaries and passionate people, thinkers and doers come together to feed the world, slow climate change and create healthier, more sustainable lives for all. This is an opportunity to launch your career with a global leader committed to #HealthForAll #HungerForNone. Bring your ideas, your skills and your passion. Your career starts here.
Intern in Integrated Process & Mathematical Solutions (all Genders)
Where do you want to go? What would you like to do? What do you want to achieve?
An internship at Bayer is your chance to give your career a kick-start in a global organization that wants to achieve the unattainable.
Process Design & Optimization is part of the Engineering & Technology of Bayer AG. We work on overall process engineering development and optimization of processes for chemical or biotechnological active ingredient production as well as for formulation and packaging operations. We offer committed students (m/f/d) the opportunity to gain practical experience and implement the specialist knowledge they have acquired during their studies.
YOUR TASKS AND LEARNING FIELDS
Data preparation and analysis
Support in the creation of mass and energy balances as well as in model creation and evaluation
Participation in the development of software tools (e.g. device models, occupancy planning, analysis and visualization methods)
Assistance with process and product flow simulation
Evaluation of process alternatives and process optimization
Get to know Quality by Design methods in a GMP-regulated environment
Who You Are
Study of pharmaceutical engineering, life science engineering, biological or chemical engineering, process engineering or a comparable field of study
In-depth specialist knowledge in the respective field of study
Previous knowledge of process simulation or programming is an advantage
Belief that you learn throughout your life and that the lessons you learn from failure lead to success
Enjoy working in a team as well as commitment and motivation
High willingness to learn and quick comprehension
Fluent written and spoken German and English skills
Our benefits package is flexible, appreciative, and tailored to your lifestyle, because: What matters to you, matters to us!
For a full-time position, you can expect an attractive salary of € 2.280,00 gross per month
Depending on the nature of your job, flexible work arrangements can be made in alignment with your manager
We support your growth through access to professional development and learning opportunities, such as LinkedIn Learning and our language learning platform Education First
We encourage sustainable mobility by providing climate-friendly transportation options such as job tickets and bike sharing
As one of our perks, our Corporate Benefits program grants you access to sales discounts from more than 150 brands
We embrace diversity by providing an inclusive work environment in which you are welcomed, supported, and encouraged to bring your whole self to work
Be curious. Be Bayer.
We offer you a voluntary internship or the option of a compulsory internship for at least 4 months. Please apply online with your complete documents: cover letter including start date and duration, CV, latest transcript of records.
We can only consider your application if all three documents are fully uploaded. We look forward to meeting you
.
Do you sometimes feel burnt out by bureaucracy? We do too. That's why we're changing the way we work - for higher productivity, faster innovation and better results. We call it Dynamic Shared Ownership (DSO). Find out more about what DSO will mean for you in your new role here: https://www.bayer.com/en/strategy/strategy
YOUR APPLICATION
Local regulations and legal requirements vary per country of hire and will be discussed with considered candidates individually based on their potential of hire.
Bayer welcomes applications from all individuals, regardless of race, national origin, gender, age, physical characteristics, social origin, disability, union membership, religion, family status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression or any unlawful criterion under applicable law. We are committed to treating all applicants fairly and avoiding discrimination.
Bayer is committed to providing barrier-free access and support-facilities for individuals with disabilities - during the application process and beyond. Applicants with disabilities are encouraged to request any support / equipment they may need via the contact information below.
